sources.title: GitHub - adventists-ai/duplexjev: Batched speech decisions without ...
sources.snippet: Built on Ultravox (training code and projector design), Qwen3 and Qwen3-ASR, and the ZJU audio-gender-benchmark. Typed single-token decisions follow the "System-One" line of work popularised by Jev. Batched speech decisions without decoding: typed single-token readout from a frozen speech LLM for full-duplex spoken agents (Speech-to-Decision).
